label: Institution ID
description: Unique six-digit IPEDS identifier for each institution. Stable across years and surveys — use as the join key across all IPEDS tables.
nces_title: Unique identification number of the institution
alignment_notes: Matches UNITID in all other IPEDS survey files. Cross-referenceable with College Scorecard and NSLDS.

label: Institution name
description: Legal name of the institution as reported to IPEDS.

label: County FIPS
description: Five-digit county FIPS code (state + county). Zero-padded to ensure leading zeros are preserved.
era_notes: Not available before 2009. Pre-2009 institutions can be geolocated via ZIP-to-county crosswalk (planned).
alignment_notes: Standard Census FIPS code. Joins directly to ACS (B-tables) BLS QCEW and other county-level federal datasets. Matches geoid in cori.data.pep.

label: County name
description: Name of the county in which the institution is located as reported to IPEDS.

label: State abbreviation
description: Two-letter postal abbreviation for the state in which the institution is located.

label: City
description: City in which the institution is located as reported to IPEDS.

label: Street address
description: Street address or post office box as reported to IPEDS.
nces_title: Street address or post office box

label: ZIP code
description: Five-digit ZIP code of the institution.

label: Latitude
description: Latitude coordinate of the institution in decimal degrees. Enables spatial joins to any geographic boundary file.
alignment_notes: Use with longitude to assign institutions to any geography: MSA rural/urban classification custom regions etc.

label: Longitude
description: Longitude coordinate of the institution in decimal degrees. Enables spatial joins to any geographic boundary file.
alignment_notes: Use with latitude to assign institutions to any geography: MSA rural/urban classification custom regions etc.

label: Sector code
description: Nine-category sector combining control (public / nonprofit / for-profit) and level (4-year / 2-year / <2-year). Code 0 = administrative unit; 99 = not assigned.

label: Funding source code
description: Control of institution: 1 = Public; 2 = Private nonprofit; 3 = Private for-profit.

label: Institution level code
description: Highest level of degree or certificate program offered: 1 = Four or more years; 2 = At least two but less than four years; 3 = Less than two years.

label: HBCU flag code
description: Whether the institution is a Historically Black College or University as designated by the U.S. Department of Education. 1 = Yes; 2 = No.

label: Hospital flag code
description: Whether the institution owns or operates a hospital. 1 = Yes; 2 = No.

label: Tribal college flag code
description: Whether the institution is a tribal college or university as defined by the Tribally Controlled Colleges and Universities Assistance Act of 1978. 1 = Yes; 2 = No.

label: Degree-granting status code
description: Whether the institution is degree-granting: 1 = Degree-granting; 2 = Non-degree-granting. All county-level aggregations in this package are restricted to degree-granting institutions (code = 1).

label: Carnegie classification code
description: 2000 Carnegie Classification code. Categories distinguish research universities, doctoral universities, master's colleges, baccalaureate colleges, associate's colleges, and special-focus institutions. See NCES data dictionary for full code list.
era_notes: NCES renamed this column from CARNEGIE (2010–2023) to C00CARNEGIE in 2024. The reconciler normalizes C00CARNEGIE back to CARNEGIE so this mapping works consistently across all vintages. Values are unchanged.

label: Highest level offered code
description: Highest award level offered by the institution. Ranges from certificates of less than one year (code 1) through doctoral degrees (code 11).

label: Highest degree offered code
description: Highest degree offered by the institution: 0 = Non-degree-granting; 1 = Certificate; 2 = Associate's; 3 = Bachelor's; 4 = Master's; 5 = Doctor's; 6 = First professional.

label: Undergrad degree offered code
description: Whether the institution offers undergraduate degree or certificate programs. 1 = Yes; 2 = No.

label: Graduate degree offered code
description: Whether the institution offers graduate degree or certificate programs. 1 = Yes; 2 = No.

label: Urbanization level code
description: Degree of urbanization using the NCES urban-centric locale classification. Large city (11) through remote rural (43). See NCES locale codes for full taxonomy.
alignment_notes: Locale codes align with NCES locale framework used across CCD and other NCES surveys.

label: Land grant flag code
description: Whether the institution is a land-grant university as designated under the Morrill Acts. 1 = Yes; 2 = No. Land-grant institutions receive federal funding for agriculture engineering and mechanical arts research and are disproportionately located in rural areas.

label: Institution size code
description: Enrollment-based size classification: 1 = Under 1000; 2 = 1000–4999; 3 = 5000–9999; 4 = 10000–19999; 5 = 20000 or more. -1 = not reported.

label: CIP code
description: Six-digit Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code identifying the program of study. Format: xx.xxxx. CIP 2020 taxonomy used from 2020 onwards; CIP 2010 used prior.
era_notes: CIP taxonomy updated in 2020; some programs recoded. Use NCES CIP crosswalk for pre/post 2020 comparisons.
alignment_notes: NCES CIP taxonomy. Crosswalk between CIP 2010 and 2020 available at nces.ed.gov/ipeds/cipcode.

label: Award level code
description: IPEDS award level code identifying the type of degree or certificate: 2–3 = Associate's; 5 = Bachelor's; 7 = Master's; 17 = Doctoral (research/scholarship); 18 = Doctoral (professional practice); 19 = Doctoral (other). County aggregations use codes 2 3 5 7 17 18 19 only.
era_notes: Doctoral degree codes changed in 2009: pre-2009 used codes 9/10/11; post-2009 uses 17/18/19. This package starts at 2010 so only 17/18/19 appear.

label: Completions to men
description: Total awards and degrees conferred to men in the reporting year for the given CIP code and award level.

label: Completions to women
description: Total awards and degrees conferred to women in the reporting year for the given CIP code and award level.

label: Total completions
description: Total awards and degrees conferred to all recipients in the reporting year for the given CIP code and award level. Sum of all race/ethnicity and gender categories.

label: Cohort type code
description: Graduation rate cohort type (GRTYPE). Defines the entering cohort: 1 = Full-time first-time bachelor's degree seeking (the primary cohort used for county aggregations); 2–8 = subcohorts by race/ethnicity and gender.
alignment_notes: County-level grad rates use cohort type 1 (full-time first-time bachelor's seekers) to match the federally reported 6-year graduation rate standard used in College Scorecard and IPEDS Graduation Rates component.

label: Graduation rate status code
description: CHRTSTAT code indicating the denominator or numerator role of the record: 12 = Adjusted cohort (denominator); 13 = Completers within 150% of normal time (numerator); 20 = Transfer-out students.

label: Cohort size
description: Number of students in the graduation rate cohort for the given cohort type and status.

label: Institution count
description: Total number of degree-granting institutions with a valid county FIPS code operating in the county in the given year. Excludes administrative units (sector 0) and non-degree-granting institutions.

label: Public institution count
description: Number of degree-granting public institutions (sector codes 1 4 7) in the county.

label: Nonprofit institution count
description: Number of degree-granting private nonprofit institutions (sector codes 2 5 8) in the county.

label: Four-year institution count
description: Number of degree-granting four-year or above institutions (sector codes 1 2 3) in the county.

label: Two-year institution count
description: Number of degree-granting two-year institutions (sector codes 4 5 6) in the county.

label: HBCU count
description: Number of Historically Black Colleges and Universities (degree-granting) in the county.

label: Tribal college count
description: Number of tribal colleges and universities (degree-granting) in the county.

label: Total degrees conferred
description: Total awards and degrees conferred by degree-granting institutions in the county across all tracked award levels (associate's through doctoral; AWLEVEL codes 2 3 5 7 17 18 19). This is the denominator for all share_degrees_* variables.

label: Share associate degrees
description: Proportion of tracked degrees conferred at the associate's level (AWLEVEL 2–3). Value is between 0 and 1. Raw count is recoverable as value × agg_var, where agg_var = count_degrees_total.

label: Share bachelor degrees
description: Proportion of tracked degrees conferred at the bachelor's level (AWLEVEL 5). Value is between 0 and 1. Raw count recoverable as value × agg_var.

label: Share master degrees
description: Proportion of tracked degrees conferred at the master's level (AWLEVEL 7). Value is between 0 and 1. Raw count recoverable as value × agg_var.

label: Share doctoral degrees
description: Proportion of tracked degrees conferred at the doctoral level (AWLEVEL 17 18 19). Value is between 0 and 1. Raw count recoverable as value × agg_var.
era_notes: Doctoral level codes changed in 2009 (9/10/11 → 17/18/19). Package covers 2010+ so only post-revision codes appear.

label: Share degrees to men
description: Proportion of tracked degrees conferred to men across all levels. Value is between 0 and 1. Raw count recoverable as value × agg_var.
alignment_notes: Complement of share_degrees_women. The two sum to 1 for any county-year with completions data.

label: Share degrees to women
description: Proportion of tracked degrees conferred to women across all levels. Value is between 0 and 1. Raw count recoverable as value × agg_var.
alignment_notes: Complement of share_degrees_men. The two sum to 1 for any county-year with completions data.

label: 150% graduation rate
description: Proportion of first-time full-time bachelor's degree-seeking students (cohort type 1) who completed their program within 150% of normal time (i.e. within 6 years for a 4-year program). Computed as CHRTSTAT 13 / CHRTSTAT 12.
alignment_notes: Matches the federally reported 6-year graduation rate used in College Scorecard. County value is the weighted average across all degree-granting institutions with a valid cohort (CHRTSTAT 12 > 0).

label: Transfer-out rate
description: Proportion of the adjusted cohort (CHRTSTAT 12) who transferred to another institution without completing (CHRTSTAT 20). Computed as CHRTSTAT 20 / CHRTSTAT 12.
